The Policy, Politics and Governance Foundation (PPGF)
Presents young professionals with an immersive

The Fellowship intends to empower passionate students and exceptional professionals with the necessary skill set to succeed in policy making and political strategy consulting. After completing a customized training program, Fellows will be assigned to work at the offices of leading policymakers, public leaders, and administrators, providing them with valuable insights into policymaking and politics.
Before deployment, Fellows undergo intensive classroom training led by subject matter experts, covering:
Analyzing political, social, and cultural frameworks.
Strategies for elections, media relations, and voter engagement
Insights into legislative processes and policymaking.
Decoding the intersection of governance, law, and fiscal policies.
After completing their training, Fellows are placed in the offices of leading public figures, gaining hands-on exposure to:
Drafting inputs on bills, parliamentary questions, and policy discussions
Managing social media and political communications
Assisting in election campaigns and constituency strategy
Conducting in-depth policy research and legislative analysis
